scope: Design comparison only. Desktop and terminal have separate color values within one identity. No live configuration or selected identity is changed.
feedback: Balanced+ is selected for the terminal, alongside the crisper warm desktop. Other terminal samples remain comparison references.

terminal.name: Balanced
terminal.basis: Moderate rose, sage, gold, blue, violet, and teal families with deliberate darker normal and lighter bright entries. Separation within each pair takes priority over maximum saturation.
terminal.extended_colors: Entries 16-255 and application-owned RGB colors remain independent. Faint text, application backgrounds, and native rendering require separate review.

terminal_reference.name: Vivid
terminal_reference.basis: Material Darker's stronger color family from the preceding terminal setup, adjusted for distinct normal/bright pairs, Clear Blue continuity, and a black background.
terminal_reference.extended_colors: Entries 16-255 and application-owned RGB colors remain independent. Faint text, application backgrounds, and native rendering require separate review.

terminal_samples.name: Balanced +
terminal_samples.basis: Start with a 40% sRGB-channel blend from Balanced to Vivid. Lower normal colored entries only where needed to keep at least 1.45:1 normal/bright luminance separation; framing and warm foreground remain fixed.

terminal_samples.name: Rich
terminal_samples.basis: Start with a 70% sRGB-channel blend from Balanced to Vivid. Lower normal colored entries only where needed to keep at least 1.45:1 normal/bright luminance separation; framing and warm foreground remain fixed.
